findings.evidence: NEW finding — POS suivi displays 0,00 € for EVERY order card. State 08 DOM grep on 'tracker-card-total' returns 31 spans, all 'tracker-card-total">0,00 €'. Kiosk order N°A0034 was paid on the kiosk for 2,00 € (state 05-kiosk-payment-screen PNG shows giant 'TOTAL À RÉGLER : €2,00' card and 'Confirmer — €2,00' CTA), the order arrives at POS suivi in CONFIRMÉES at 0,00 €. State 01-pos-supervisor-baseline DOM also shows 30/30 cards with tracker-card-total = 0,00 € across pre-existing orders. Run-3 reviewer claimed totals 'now read 2,00€ correctly' — that claim is contradicted by the run-4 evidence (visual + DOM). This is a P0 cross-surface numeric integrity bug per protocol category #11: the cashier sees an incorrect zero total for orders that have actually been paid; reconciliation, refunds, and Z-report risk are immediate. Whether this is regression from run-3 or a misread by run-3 reviewer cannot be determined without re-running run-3 artifacts (overwritten); either way run-4 is broken.
findings.fix_hint: Trace the POS suivi tracker-card-total binding. Either (a) the tracker card is bound to a draft total instead of the persisted order_total (compute order.grand_total in the API serializer feeding /api/admin/orders/* used by Suivi commandes), or (b) the kiosk order is created without total_amount in the orders table (verify Kiosk\Order::create payload includes total). Add an integration test that asserts $order->total_amount === $payment->amount after kiosk checkout.

findings.evidence: NEW finding — orange top banner 'Reconnexion en cours...' rendered on 09-kds-prete PNG. This is a different surface than the run-3 'Mode secours actif' banner (correctly gated under C-008). 'Reconnexion en cours' is the websocket reconnection state shown when laravel-websockets is unreachable (consoles confirm `WebSocket connection to ws://127.0.0.1:6001/...failed: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`). It is a transient state that should fade once WS reconnects, but in the iter15 test environment WS is never started so it sticks the entire run. Visually distracting. Lower severity than C-008/C-025 because it accurately reflects current connection state, but it is still a 'system-broken' visual cue.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) start the laravel-websockets/soketi service as part of the Playwright setup so reconnection succeeds, or (b) suppress the 'Reconnexion en cours' overlay in non-production env (mirror C-008 appEnv gate). Decision: prefer (a) so we test the realtime path properly.

findings.evidence: NEW finding (or pre-existing but never flagged). Network log on 01-kds-baseline shows 403 on /api/admin/stock/low-alerts and 403 on /api/admin/fiscal/z-report (also present on 01-pos-supervisor-baseline). These endpoints are queried by the chef-cuisine / caissier shells but the role lacks admin permission. Per protocol, 403 is unexpected unless on auth-redirect/422-form-state allowlist. The widgets that consume these endpoints likely render an empty state silently — DOM grep does not find a [role=alert] near them. Reference user memory 'admin@lecayenne.fr / 123456 + permission caveat for observability/stock-rupture routes': this is the documented permission caveat now surfacing on KDS+POS surfaces too, not just admin.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) gate the low-alerts / z-report widgets behind a role check so they don't fire for chef-cuisine / caissier (cleanest), or (b) expose a non-admin variant of the endpoint with role-scoped data. Currently the components render 'silently empty' which is protocol category #6 silent_error.

findings.evidence: NEW finding. Network log shows POST /api/frontend/order/quote returns 401 Unauthorized at the kiosk payment screen (state 05). The kiosk surface should be either guest-token authenticated or behind a kiosk-session middleware; a 401 indicates the quote API is not reachable for the kiosk session. Visible UI still shows €2,00 because a fallback total is rendered, but the absence of a backend-confirmed quote is concerning per CLAUDE.md non-negotiable principle #7 'Backend is the source of truth for pricing'. If the quote endpoint is silently failing, the kiosk could display a stale or client-computed total that diverges from what the order is created with.
findings.fix_hint: Audit middleware on /api/frontend/order/quote — should accept the kiosk session token. Add a smoke-test asserting 200 OK with computed backend total before the kiosk allows payment confirmation. Cross-reference with C-026 which suggests pricing ingestion to POS suivi is also broken.
